verdict.rationale: Brex documents setting rules for how employees spend, what they must document, and who approves, with Brex AI applying them to every transaction (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-41). It also offers auto-enforced limits by spend type such as stipends, travel, and procurement, plus blocking of out-of-policy purchases (brex-docs-9, brex-docs-36, brex-docs-39). A review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions (brex-docs-16, brex-docs-15), and the Budgets API supports spend limits (brex-docs-5). missing for 10: explicit documentation of role- and context-based expense policy dimensions (role-based routing is only shown for bill pay), detailed first-party docs beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
